high_level_description: This image captures a bustling street scene during what appears to be late afternoon or early evening, as suggested by the warm, golden light casting long shadows. The setting is an urban area with a prominent statue of a person on horseback situated in the center of the image. The statue is mounted on a tall pedestal, which has some inscriptions that are not clearly legible from the image. The street is multi-lane, with vehicles moving in both directions. On the left side of the image, there is a Nissan SUV driving towards the camera, and a motorcyclist is riding past it.
